architecture: Qwen3 dense decoder (pre-norm RMSNorm, grouped-query attention with per-head query and key norms and full rotary embedding, gated SiLU FFN), no vocabulary head: the output is the final-norm row of a text's last token

sources.checkpoint_config: config.json at the pinned revision, read 2026-11-22
sources.geometry_note: Qwen3ForCausalLM weights without lm_head: 36 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query heads over 8 key heads of 128, FFN 12288, vocab 151665, rope theta 1e6 over the whole head, rms_norm_eps 1e-6
known_gaps: one rank only: the 151665-row vocabulary does not split evenly and the stage is built and measured at TP1
BF16 weights only; the publisher ships no FP8 checkpoint
sources.precision_policy: weights and activations BF16 with FP32 accumulation; every norm rounds the normalised value to BF16 before its BF16 gain, rotary terms and the SiLU are rounded before their products, as the publisher's bfloat16 modules do
sources.pooling: the tokenizer appends <|endoftext|> (151643) to a text; the embedding is the final-norm row at that token, divided by its L2 norm in FP32
